protocol.boundary_train: all eligible initial-condition arrays except 3.9<=D<=4.1; interpolate on normalized phase without duplicating plot file
protocol.baseline: linear interpolation in D for radial fields; nearest dimension interpolation for boundary
protocol.geometry: g=e^(-2tau) a^2 [[x^2-f^2,-x],[-x,1]], radius=e^(-tau)x, null slopes x±f, Ricci from psi_- = U*(D-2)^1.5/2 and psi_+ = V*(D-2)^1.5/2, Misner-Sharp compactness=1-a^-2; proper time fixed x only where |x|<f
negative_controls: do not treat self-similarity horizon as event horizon
limitations: same upstream solver family, not independent observational evidence
no full supercritical evolution, no event horizon reconstruction
no full Riemann or Kretschmann evaluation at R2
raw data retrieved at runtime rather than republished in git
plot configuration derivative excluded from training duplication
